lines: /* Perspective ray tracer: sphere, checkerboard, and directional lighting. */
double hit(V o,V d){V q=add(o,(V){0,-1,5});double a=dot(d,d),b=dot(q,d),c=dot(q,q)-1,h=b*b-a*c;if(h<0)return 1e30;double t=(-b-sqrt(h))/a;return t>1e-5?t:1e30;}
double t=hit(o,d),p=d.y<0?-1.5/d.y:1e30;double r,g,b;if(t< p){V n=add(add(o,mul(d,t)),(V){0,-1,5});double s=.2+.8*fmax(0,dot(n,l));r=s;g=b=.2*s;}
